title: Bagasse

review.classification: Independent read of 39141 and 39149 confirms the cane juice extraction fibre and the exclusion from other sugar wastes. This record supports only the wet untreated whole material before depithing.
review.release_and_receiver: The direct procurement original identifies undepithed loose bagasse and documents condition-specific transport controls. The Mysore mill case demonstrates the distinct pre-depithing transfer. Tender controls apply as examples of documentation, with no claim of actual deliveries or default loss.
review.quantity_and_allocation: Calibrated wet first-release mass Q, independently observed moisture, distinct delivery service and explicit zero-output handling align in both languages. Supplier cane and extraction responsibilities enter once. Joint allocation remains explicit at the responsible operation and preserves gross physical balances.
review.native_and_bilingual: Verified exact digests for 18 historical public native detail originals. Their specific flow scope and property chain are treated as historical support, with unresolved reference product and other unverified bindings declared. English and Chinese retain the same process states, reference basis, waste roles and original-cohort service accounting.

sources.role: Reviewed procurement original. PDF pages 29–34 identify the undepithed loose material, with separate cover conditions in the main tender.
Mill-authored wet raw input before depithing; no transfer of stock or yield figures.
Qualitative joint extraction topology, with actual upstream supplier responsibility required.

delivery_gate: Full npm run validate is required on the exact integration source.
